findings.title: Validation Commands Not Observed in Execution Traces
findings.consequence: User mentions running validation commands like 'make test' (5 occurrences) but no actual command executions captured in session logs, preventing validation habit analysis
causeChain: No edit events observed in analyzed sessions
Test commands appear in user requests but never execute
Unclear whether editing or validation habits exist

repair.prompt: Configure execution tracing for validation commands
steps: Add script execution hooks for make/test/npm test commands
Enable command logging in session tracking
Re-analyze sessions to capture validation patterns

findings.reason: Critical gap between stated intent (validation) and observable behavior prevents confident assessment of development workflow quality

findings.title: Failed Event Friction Impacting Session Outcomes
findings.consequence: Three failed-event friction signals detected across analyzed sessions, causing user re-attempts and reduced productivity
causeChain: Model requests fail during tool execution attempts
Turns finish with errors rather than completion
User must re-attempt or recover from failures
findings.evidence: 3 bounded error sessions identified in friction taxonomy

repair.prompt: Investigate failed event patterns and implement better error handling
steps: Open bounded sessions behind failed-event category
Identify specific tool or API failures
Implement retry logic or clearer error messages

findings.reason: Direct user impact from repeated failures; requires immediate investigation to restore confidence in session outcomes

findings.title: Long Skill Documents Lack Progressive Disclosure Structure
findings.consequence: 13 skill files exceed reasonable length thresholds without local Markdown references, creating navigation friction for developers
causeChain: Skills like neon-functions (490 lines), visual-plan (549 lines) contain extensive detail inline
Readers must navigate long documents to find key information
Reference structure not leveraged for deepening
findings.evidence: 13 of 31 skills flagged; top offenders: visual-plan (549 lines), neon-functions (490 lines), neon-postgres (376 lines)

repair.prompt: Refactor long skill documents to use progressive disclosure with reference files
steps: Extract detailed explanations into separate .md reference files
Keep SKILL.md focused on core workflow and triggers
Verify links render correctly in Qoder interface

findings.reason: Maintainability debt that accumulates over time; reduces discoverability but doesn't block current work

findings.title: Memory Title Collisions Require Governance Review
findings.consequence: 3 exact title collisions and 2 similarity pairs detected in project memory titles, potentially causing retrieval ambiguity
causeChain: Duplicate memories created without title uniqueness checks
Similar titles indicate semantic overlap needing manual review
May cause confusion when querying memories
findings.evidence: 42 project memories scanned; collisions: Fleet_Pi_Project_Introduction (2x), Fleet_Pi_Tech_Stack (2x), Prettier+Tailwind_Plugin_Configuration (2x); Similarity pairs at 81% and 80%

repair.prompt: Review and merge duplicate or highly similar memory titles
steps: Open each collision pair in Qoder interface
Merge duplicates preserving most complete content

findings.reason: Governance issue that affects long-term maintainability but can be resolved through manual review process

findings.title: Extended Session Durations Suggest Complex Tasks Without Decomposition
findings.consequence: One active session lasted 46 minutes with multiple long spans, indicating potential opportunity for task decomposition and checkpoint patterns
causeChain: Tasks not broken into smaller, completable units
Continuous work without checkpoints or closures
May increase cognitive load and reduce recovery points
findings.evidence: 34 sessions analyzed; 1 active-long session at 46m; 3 additional long spans mainly idle or resumed work

repair.prompt: Consider task decomposition strategies for complex work spanning long durations
steps: Review task complexity for sessions exceeding 30 minutes
Use delegation or subagent patterns for independent subtasks
Monitor outcomes to assess efficiency improvements

findings.reason: Efficiency opportunity identified through duration data alone; outcome quality evidence incomplete so prioritized but low severity
